Photo matching by name, darker pictures and print adjustments.

### What's changed
- **No gap beside the ID photo.** The zoom slider in the person editor could stop just short of filling the photo frame, so moving the photo left a thin gap down one side. Zoom now snaps to filling the frame, and to the whole photo, when it's close.
- **See the photo size a template needs.** The template builder, the import screen and the person editor show the ID photo size the template's photo frame needs, such as *At least 360 × 480 px · 30.5 × 40.6 mm · 3:4 portrait*.
- **Darker backgrounds, logos and photos.** In the template builder, the background picture, logos and the ID photo frame have **Darkness**, **Contrast** and **Colour**. Darkness darkens the whole picture, white areas too. They show on screen and print on the card.
- **Import photos by name.** When importing people from a CSV, each photo is matched by the person's full name, first name then last name. Capitals, spaces, dashes, underscores and macrons don't matter: `John Smith.jpg`, `JOHN SMITH.jpg`, `johnsmith.jpg` and `JohnSmith.jpg` all match John Smith. The blank CSV no longer has ID or ID Photo columns: photos are found by name, so photos named by number (`1.jpg`, `7.jpg`) no longer match; rename them after the people. Two people with the same name are imported without a photo, so they don't share one; add theirs by editing them.
- **Print adjustments.** Settings now has **Darkness**, **Contrast** and **Colour**, for printers that print lighter or duller than the screen, and **Overprint edges**, for a printer that leaves a thin white edge. For an HID FARGO HDP5000, HDP5600 or HDPii they're set automatically, and you can turn **Automatic** off to set them yourself. They change only what is sent to the printer. Templates, previews and proof sheets stay as designed.
- **Made for HID FARGO printers.** Print adjustments keep white unprinted. Both these and the template's picture settings keep pure black only where the design has it, so the resin black panel prints exactly what was designed. The user guide has a new section on the HDP5000 driver's own colour settings: Dye-Sub Intensity, Print All Black with K Panel and more.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients and people.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.11 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.11.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
